description.en-US: Richard Gibbons's 1599 English version of Louis of Granada's Doctrina espiritual: six treatises on mental prayer, vocal prayer, remedies against temptations, a rule of Christian life, the sacrament of Penance, and preparation for Communion. The treatises are divided differently from the Spanish book, so it is its own book.
description.pt-BR: A versão inglesa de Richard Gibbons (1599) da Doutrina espiritual de Luís de Granada.

sources.edition: A Spiritual Doctrine conteining a rule to live well, with divers praiers and meditations, newly translated out of Spanish into English by Richard Gibbons (Louvain: Laurence Kellam, 1599), EEBO-TCP A06450.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription (A06450), old spelling kept; long s printed as s, vv as w. 175 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Marginal notes are footnotes. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Printed 1599; the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
